description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—measured by Micro F1 score (%) as a function of the number of samples generated, with the x-axis labeled "Number of Samples Generated" and marked at K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis represents the Micro F1 (%) score, ranging from 25 to 55. The TACRED method, represented by a blue line with circular markers, shows a steady increase from approximately 24% at K=16 to 43% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit method, shown in orange with triangular markers, starts at around 24% and rises to about 43% at K=64, following a similar trend to TACRED. The Re-TACRED method, depicted in green with diamond markers, begins at approximately 35% and increases sharply to 50% at K=64. The SemEval method, represented by a red line with square markers, starts at about 43% and rises to 55% at K=64, showing the highest performance across all sample sizes. All methods exhibit an upward trend in Micro F1 score as the number of generated samples increases.
